pictures.name: XY1-Yao-Travels
pictures.prompt: Ancient China in legendary times, a winding mountain path through misty pines. Yao, a dignified older emperor with a long grey beard, in simple yellow silk robes and a plain black cap, walks with two attendants, one carrying a burning torch even in daylight, toward a small thatched hut beside a clear river in the valley below. Soft morning light, blue mountain shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.prompt: Ancient China, beside a thatched hut on a clear river. Xu You, a lean hermit in his sixties with a white topknot and wispy beard, in a patched grey hemp robe and straw sandals, sits on a flat river rock, calm and amused. Behind the emperor an attendant holds a burning torch that looks pale in the bright sunlight. Golden light on the water.
